newsitem.title: INDIA: India may import one mln tonnes wheat - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: India may import one mln tonnes wheat - newspaper.

text.p: An Indian newspaper said on Wednesday that the government was considering importing one million tonnes of wheat to increase domestic supplies and check rising prices.
"The government is considering import of one million tonnes of wheat as a short-term measure to arrest the spiralling wheat prices," the Economic Times said.
The daily quoted State Trading Corp (STC) chairman B.K. Chaturvedi as saying the imported wheat would be used for re-export and help check rising prices.
Government officials were not immediately available for comment.
Traders said on Tuesday a fall in government reserves had driven up wheat prices in recent months by about 20 percent compared with prices a year ago.
They said traders were hoarding stocks, expecting to sell later when government would authorise wheat product exports.
